faq_heading: Vancouver condos under $600,000: your questions answered

faq.q: How many Vancouver condos sell for under $600,000?
faq.a: 406 of 3,595, or 11%. A further 1,478 sold in the next range up, $600,000 to $799,999.

faq.q: What is the median price of a condo in Vancouver?
faq.a: $733,500 from November 1, 2025 to October 31, 2026, so $600,000 is below the middle of the market. The middle half sold between $585,000 and $980,000.

faq.q: Which Vancouver area has the lowest condo prices?
faq.a: Collingwood, at $520,000 across 149 sales at $836 a square foot, median year built 2007. The highest of the 10 lowest was Grandview Woodland at $664,900.

faq.q: How fast do Vancouver condos sell?
faq.a: 21 days at the median, closing at 97.1% of the last list price, with 8% above list.

blocks.text: Draft for Jared’s approval. Figures are Paragon closed and pending sales to October 31, 2026. A pending sale is firm but has not completed, so its price can still change. A median is shown only where at least 5 homes sold. The live search is not connected yet (Jerry’s saved search, price filter $600,000).

In Vancouver, 406 of the 3,595 condos (11%) sold under $600,000. The median was $733,500, with the middle half between $585,000 and $980,000. The busiest price range, $600,000 to $799,999, had 1,478 sales.

blocks.text: Buying a condo under $600,000 in Vancouver

In Collingwood the median condo sold for $520,000 across 149 sales, $80,000 under $600,000. Across Vancouver the median condo took 21 days to sell and closed at 97.1% of the last list price, with 8% of the 3,595 sales above list. Check the strata fee and depreciation report.
